name: 蘇倚德
objective:
本課程具焦著作權重要概念及新興議題，其中涉及人工智慧應用、傳統智慧表達、時尚娛樂產業，以建立當代著作權體系知識。

This course focuses on key concepts and emerging issues in copyright law, including the application of artificial intelligence, traditional expressions of knowledge, and the fashion and entertainment industries, with the aim of establishing a comprehensive understanding of the contemporary copyright system.
